BlueprintIdentity.description:
Identifies a blueprint document by application, name and content hash.

This is identity, not location: compare `DeferredBlueprintRef`, which
locates the blueprint file an upstream step will write.

kind.description: The kind of document referenced; selects the model a reference loads as.
kind.title: Kind

application.description: The application the referenced blueprint belongs to.
application.title: Application

name.description: The name of the referenced blueprint.
name.title: Name

content_hash.description: A fingerprint of the referenced blueprint's configuration.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

BlueprintIdentity.title: BlueprintIdentity

ExecutionFacts.description:
What ran a step: the scheduler and the allocation it was granted, read from
the step's own environment.

These are the granted resources, never the request: the request is in the
transformed workplan and the batch script. They describe the step's own
process; a model run the step submits as a job of its own is not described.

scheduler.description:
`slurm` when the step ran inside a SLURM job, else `local`; empty in a
record written before schema 1.2.0.
scheduler.title: Scheduler

job_id.description: The id of the SLURM job the step ran in; empty outside SLURM.
job_id.title: Job Id

host.description: The host the step process ran on; under SLURM, the batch node.
host.title: Host

pid.description: The id of the step process.
pid.title: Pid

nodes.description: The nodes granted to the job; zero outside SLURM or when not reported.
nodes.title: Nodes

tasks.description: The tasks granted to the job; zero outside SLURM or when not reported.
tasks.title: Tasks

cpus.description:
The CPUs granted per node, on the node the step process ran on; zero outside
SLURM or when not reported.
cpus.title: Cpus

partition.description: The partition the job ran in; empty outside SLURM or when not reported.
partition.title: Partition

account.description: The account the job was charged to; empty outside SLURM or when not reported.
account.title: Account

ExecutionFacts.title: ExecutionFacts

Product.description: A file or directory a step produced.

kind.description:
The classification of the product: one of `ArtifactKind` when written by
this release. Kept as text on disk so a record written with a kind this
build no longer knows still loads; `known_kind` maps it for consumers.
kind.title: Kind

path.description: The location of the product, relative to the step root.
path.title: Path

size_bytes.description: The size of the product in bytes; zero when not measured.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

sha256.description: The content digest of the product; empty when not computed.
sha256.title: Sha256

metadata.description: Model-specific detail, such as an output stream.
metadata.title: Metadata

Product.title: Product

description: What a step did: written by the step process, in its working directory.

schema_version.description: The schema version for the document.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

run_id.description: The run the step belongs to; empty for a standalone `cstar blueprint run`.
run_id.title: Run Id

blueprint_schema_version.description: The schema version of the blueprint the step ran.
blueprint_schema_version.title: Blueprint Schema Version

blueprint_file.description:
The blueprint file the step ran, such as `work/<stem>.ovrd.yaml`, relative to
the step root; empty when it lies outside the step root.
blueprint_file.title: Blueprint File

outcome.description: The runner's execution status as its lowercase name, e.g. `completed`.
outcome.title: Outcome

start_at.description: When the step process started; `None` when it never started.
start_at.title: Start At

finished_at.description: When the step process recorded its outcome.
finished_at.title: Finished At

system.description: The C-Star system the step ran on.
system.title: System

versions.description: The versions of the packages the step ran with.
versions.title: Versions

title: StepRecord
